description: Publish an agent's stream on OpenVibe.Live (the Agent Streams plan, S1). POST /api/streams/agent creates the agent stream and its publish ticket, POST /api/streams/agent/:id/ticket renews that ticket, DELETE /api/streams/agent/:id/ticket revokes it (the kill switch: Live ends the WHIP session at once), POST /api/streams/agent/:id/curtain raises the desk's privacy screen, PUT /api/streams/agent/:id/frame sends the last frame while Live wants no video, POST /api/streams/agent/:id/end ends the stream, and GET /api/streams/agent/:id/state tells the desk whether to encode, and POST /api/streams/agent/:id/control is one of the four controls (pause, curtain, mute, end) with the moderator rules of the Agent Streams plan, S5. The publish capability also covers the step credit: a step may name the suggestion it took ("Suggested by @mira"). The caller is the person's own session token, or a first-party service token acting for that person (a Node principal acting for its owner, Codes or Actor) that holds this capability for the audience openvibe.live: Network grants it to exactly those principals. Never a developer-app token, never another person's stream. The Agent Streams design calls it live.agent-stream.publish; a capability id in this system carries no hyphen (the capability pattern and the token claims' cap pattern both allow letters, digits and underscores only), so the id is live.agent_stream.publish.
